description: A bunkhouse of two long rows, beds made, boots under, each locker with a name card in a brass frame and about half of them with something pinned beside the card: a photograph, a pressed flower, a drawing done by a child of a man with one arm longer than the other. A stove at each end. It smells of soap and cold iron. Nobody is in here at this hour and the floor has been swept this morning.
name: The Sleepers
